phase6er_policy: frozen safe stop retained; no overwrite, reclassification, threshold relaxation, or sample reuse
support_radius_status: engineering assumption equal to one velocity voxel; not a public Flow support radius

control_volume.plane_thickness: one channel-specific voxel centered on each declared plane
control_volume.outward_normal_contract: bottom -Z, top +Z, side left/right -/+Y, end left/right -/+X
control_volume.sample_area: product of the two tangential channel-specific voxel dimensions
control_volume.boundary_band: authored Mesh interior within one channel-specific voxel
control_volume.deep_interior: authored Mesh signed depth greater than one channel-specific voxel
control_volume.center_axis: deep interior within 0.5 channel-specific voxel of the Mesh long axis

tracer_policy: inspect public channels only; do not use private API or claim source ownership when no independent passive channel exists
